title: The Internet Under the Forest
hook: Trees in a forest send warning signals through fungi underground.
script: Trees in a forest send warning signals through fungi underground. Thin white threads wrap around their roots and link tree to tree. Through those threads, trees trade sugar, like a slow underground market. So what does a tree do when it is dying? It can pump its leftover sugar to its neighbours before the end. When insects attack one tree, the trees around it may switch on their defences. So is a forest a thousand trees, or one living community? Scientists still argue about how far the sharing really goes.
